environment: Isolated SQLite instance, real Chromium, HTTPS loopback origin

conclusion: A non-operator with an organization binding can list projects in that organization, while a request targeting a different organization receives a generic 404 and discloses no target data.
limitations: This is one GET route and one principal/role combination. It does not cover write routes, pagination/cursors, other roles, resource IDs across orgs, or concurrent scope changes. No product data was changed by the probes.
